title: When Should You Book Your Safari?
excerpt: How far in advance should you book a safari in Tanzania? It depends on the season, the lodges you want and your flexibility.
body:
## High season: 9–12 months

For July–October and the Christmas period, popular camps fill up early. Especially camps near the Mara River and in Ndutu in February.

## Shoulder season: 4–6 months

June, November and January–March outside the holidays.

## Green season: 2–4 months

April and May usually have availability, though some camps close.

## Kilimanjaro

Book at least three to six months ahead, more for holidays.

## Flights

International flights are often cheaper booked early.

## Last minute

Possible, with less choice. We will tell you honestly what is available.
